attn0.name: early context accumulator over raw token embeddings
attn0.gate: mean-ablation floor +0.101 nats; token-conditional-mean substitute recovers only 32% and linear-in-embedding 33% - genuinely contextual (it is the only attention the first four blocks contribute); consumed at block-distances 2/4/8 (blocks 2, 4, 8).

mlp0.name: DEAD (constant write: Down collapsed to bias)

mlp1.name: pure token-identity feature table (open-parenthesis / rare-token features), written for distance-8 consumption at block 9
mlp1.gate: token-conditional-mean substitution recovers 109% of the 0.148-nat floor (the table is a denoised version of the write - the module IS a token table); linear-in-embedding recovers 92%.

mlp2.name: determiner / possessive noun-phrase-onset token table (fires on ' an', ' a', ' your', ' my', ' the'), broadcast to blocks 4, 6, 10
mlp2.gate: token-conditional-mean recovers 93%, linear-in-embedding 91% of the 0.315-nat floor.

attn4.name: bulleted-list format detector and bullet-continuation promoter (fires at newline inside '- item' lists, pushes '-'/'\u2022' at readout)
attn4.gate: floor +0.249; token/linear substitutes recover only 33%/32% - contextual, as an attention module should be; direct readout consumer (0.170 nats).

mlp4.name: multi-token proper-name / rare-word completion features (fires on ' Kansas', ' Notre', 'AR'-in-AR37; pushes name-continuation fragments)
mlp4.gate: token-conditional-mean recovers 85% of the 0.199-nat floor; readout is its top consumer (0.207).

mlp6.name: subword-suffix continuation table (fires on fragments 'um', 'ak', 'ic', 'ou'), consumed by blocks 8 and 10

attn8.name: pronoun-gender and script/language context carrier (' she'/' her' code; non-Latin-script contexts)
attn8.gate: floor +0.135; substitutes recover only 30%/25% - contextual; feeds readout (0.091) and block 10.
attn8.note: the single PC story is partial: top activations mix a she/her feature with a Cyrillic/unicode feature; the module resists one name

mlp8.name: main next-token syntax engine: maps token identity + local context to the function-word / continuation distribution; the readout's largest single input (1.03 of 5.83 nats)
mlp8.gate: token-conditional-mean recovers 79%, linear 77% of the 0.673-nat source floor; the remaining ~21% is genuinely contextual.

mlp9.name: pure subword-fragment token table (fires on prefixes 'sp', 'li', 'Ch') for word-completion, consumed by blocks 10-11
mlp9.gate: token-conditional-mean substitution recovers 102% of the 0.147-nat floor - it IS a token table.

attn10.name: numbered-list / recipe-quantity line-start continuation (fires at newline in ingredient lists, pushes digits and '\n' at readout)
attn10.gate: floor +0.204; substitutes recover 28%/24% - contextual; direct readout consumer (0.099).

mlp10.name: sentence-onset capitalization promoter: fires on newline / document boundary, pushes capitalized sentence-starters ('The', 'In', 'As') and suppresses lowercase function words; second-largest readout input (0.84 nats)

attn11.name: citation-format period predictor (fires on author initials 'J. T', pushes '.', '.,', '.;' at readout)
attn11.gate: floor +0.066, readout its only consumer; substitutes recover ~7%/4% - almost purely contextual (it needs to see the initials pattern).

mlp11.name: final function-word smoothing: promotes ' the', ' to', ' a', ' that' and verb continuations after 'also'/'that'; last-write readout adjustment
mlp11.gate: token-conditional-mean recovers 56% of the 0.172-nat floor; half its function resists token-level naming.
